contributor_notes: This documentary covers the HIV/AIDS crisis in San Francisco through five interviewees (a counselor, political activist, HIV-positive artist, dancer/florist, and nurse in clinical trials). The source text does not provide the interviewees' names or explicitly state their sexual orientations or gender identities, so no queer_characters entries were drafted despite the film's strong association with the gay community's experience of the epidemic. A maintainer with access to the film should add named subjects and sourced identity tags. No director/creator names were provided in the source text. Trigger warnings drawn from the provided list: AIDS deaths and bereavement (hiv-aids, character-death); the text also mentions grief, terminal illness, and mortality which are not in the controlled vocabulary. Spicy level set to 1 as no sexual content is indicated for a documentary of interviews. Subtitle and audio language info was not mentioned in the source.
